claim: One fresh uncounted canonical six-role rehearsal completed 18 objective dispatches, defeated Lorelei, Bruno, and Agatha with every requested learned authority active, then failed closed because Agatha's receipt verifier treated one autonomous learned pivot as though it had to equal the fixed teacher's preferred specialist. This is a preserved negative result, not completion evidence.

diagnosis.finding: The learned high-level controller can request an extra temporary role pivot after a legal intervening move. Agatha's report already verifies that the declared Dugtrio and Jolteon curriculum roles attacked every required opponent position, but its separate receipt validator also required every learned pivot target to equal the deterministic teacher's preferred species.
diagnosis.why_the_old_metric_was_insufficient: Twenty-one decisions and twenty-one rebindings proves that the target head controlled every switch without fallback. It does not prove that a chapter's independent semantic contract accepted every resulting strategy.
diagnosis.verifier_posture: The completed battle was still rejected. No counted root was opened and no terminal evidence was promoted.

repair.behavior: Keep exact opponent identity and position checks, bind every recorded target index back to the observed terminal party identity, and leave specialist curriculum coverage to the existing per-turn lesson verifier. This accepts auditable learned alternatives without accepting corrupt or incomplete switch receipts.
repair.rom_free_regression: A recorded autonomous pivot to a different real party member is accepted; a receipt whose target species does not match the recorded party slot is rejected.
repair.next_gate: Regenerate the source-bound collection registry, pass the full ROM-free gate, commit and push, then retry the exact six-role stack on a fresh uncounted canonical root.
